issues.what: The green curtain reads as broader patches with less separation between the fine vertical rays, and bright stars compete more with the red fringe.
issues.fix: Restore the narrow green filaments and the softer transparent red fringe; mute the brightest nearby star cores.

issues.where: H and E, eastern South America and the night-side limb
issues.what: The warm city lights are larger and hotter, and the blue edge at the bottom reads as a more distinct line than in the target.
issues.fix: Reduce the size and intensity of the brightest lights and feather the faint blue edge into the dark ocean and sky.

issues.where: B, C, D, E, and I, surrounding star field
issues.what: Individual stars read as larger and more conspicuous against the fine dust and sky texture, most clearly beside the aurora and below the left limb.
issues.fix: Tighten and dim the stronger star points while preserving the underlying dust lanes and near-black sky.

issues.where: A, F, and G, Americas, Pacific clouds, and Arctic ice
issues.what: Terrain ridges, ice edges, and cloud streaks are more brittle and etched at native scale; some bright flecks pop out more than they do in the target.
issues.fix: Dial back local sharpening and highlight microcontrast, preserving the fine structures without the harder edges.

issues.where: B, D, F, and G, daylight atmospheric limb
issues.what: The cyan-white rim reads slightly harder where it meets the disk, especially down the left edge.
issues.fix: Reduce the edge contrast at the inner rim and blend it gradually into the blue falloff without moving the limb.

issues.what: The disk reads slightly fuller because the unlit side is more visible, and the lit edge is a little coarser.
issues.fix: Deepen the night hemisphere, refine the illuminated silhouette, and preserve the target's left-hand lighting and crater relief.

issues.where: Center sun track and foreground ocean
issues.what: The reflected sunlight and surrounding midtones are fractionally warmer and more open, softening the separation of the brightest water and the cloud shadows.
issues.fix: Trim the warm lift slightly and restore local contrast around the sun track without changing the shadow direction.

issues.where: A, F, and G, sunlit water, small cloud clusters, and long shadows
issues.what: The cloud faces and shadows are slightly lifted, and fine wavelets and glint texture read softer in places.
issues.fix: Back off the warm midtone lift, recover the finer wavelet texture, and deepen the cloud shadows slightly.

issues.where: D and H, foreground cloud banks; E and I, island shelf and nearby water
issues.what: Cloud rims and tiny glints have a slightly coarser, brighter finish against the darker ocean, including offshore around the island shelf.
issues.fix: Reduce the local bite of isolated highlights and retain the fine dark-blue and turquoise separation.
